statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Cardiac event monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The denial reason code is CO-97
The provided indication note does not document attempts at less intensive monitoring or that such options were deemed insufficient
